_comment: Every view of the app the UI capture covers. Each view opens `url` (relative to project.json app.base_url) and clicks the buttons or tabs in `clicks` (accessible name, exact match, first match). Replace the example with your app's pages, panels and tabs, and add a view whenever the app gets a new one. `ready` (top level, or per view to override) tells the capture when the app has finished loading: a CSS selector that must be visible, or "js:<expression>" that must be true. Without it the capture waits for network idle for at most 5 s, which live apps (streaming, polling, websockets) never reach.
